issue_context.title: Errors for MQTT template light after update to 0.117
issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/releases
  - Do not report issues for integrations if you are using custom components or integrations.
  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
After update HA to 0.117 there are errors in log for MQTT light template.
Errors appear after the device sends this status:
topic: `shellies/Shelly-woonkamerTV/light/0/status`
payload:
```
{"ison":true,"has_timer":false,"timer_started":0,"timer_duration":0,"timer_remaining":0,"brightness":46,"white":0,"temp":2702}
```

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Configuration -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.117.0
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 0.116.4
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): Debian 10 on WSL/HA Core/venv
- Integration causing this issue: MQTT Light, template schema
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/light.mqtt/

arch | x86_64
-- | --
dev | false
docker | false
hassio | false
installation_type | Home Assistant Core
os_name | Linux
os_version | 4.19.104-microsoft-standard
python_version | 3.8.3
timezone | Europe/Warsaw
version | 0.117.0
virtualenv | true



## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
light:
  - platform: mqtt
    schema: template
    name: "Shelly DUO Light"
    command_topic: "shellies/Shelly-woonkamerTV/light/0/set"
    state_topic: "shellies/Shelly-woonkamerTV/light/0/status"
    command_on_template: "{'turn': 'on' {% if brightness is defined %}, 'brightness': {{ brightness | float | multiply(0.3922) | round }}{ %endif %}{ %if color_temp is defined %}, 'temp': {{ (1000000 / (color_temp | int)) | round(0, 'floor') }}{% endif %}}"
    command_off_template: "{'turn':'off'}"
    state_template: "{%if value_json.ison %}on{% else %}off{% endif %}"
    brightness_template: "{{ value_json.brightness | float | multiply(2.55) | round }}"
    color_temp_template: "{{ ((1000000 / (value_json.temp | int, 2700) | max) | round(0, 'floor')) }}"
    max_mireds: 370
    min_mireds: 153
```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
2020-10-29 16:10:57 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.util.logging] Exception in state_received when handling msg on 'shellies/Shelly-woonkamerTV/light/0/status': '{"ison":true,"has_timer":false,"timer_started":0,"timer_duration":0,"timer_remaining":0,"brightness":46,"white":0,"temp":2702}'
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/home/maciek/.virtualenvs/hass/lib/python3.8/site-packages/homeassistant/components/mqtt/debug_info.py", line 35, in wrapper
msg_callback(msg)
File "/home/maciek/.virtualenvs/hass/lib/python3.8/site-packages/homeassistant/components/mqtt/light/schema_template.py", line 258, in state_received
self._templates[
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'async_render_with_possible_json_value'
```

## Additional information

review_comments: Is there no test for this?

Yes there is a test, but the problem is that the test case has both the white_value_template and a color_temp_template set so this copy-paste-error was not found.
Maybe the test could be rewritten to be parametrized, and loop over a list of templates.
